# Build Index

## Overview

This document provides the official index of the FamilyOS Build Framework.

The Build Index defines the organization of build documentation and provides
navigation between build standards, processes, automation practices, and
artifact management.

---

## Purpose

The purpose of this index is to:

- provide a central entry point for build documentation;
- define build document organization;
- improve discoverability;
- maintain traceability between build practices.

---

# Build Framework

The Build Framework defines how FamilyOS transforms source code into reliable,
validated, and reproducible artifacts.

It is organized into the following areas:

| Area | Description |
|---|---|
| Foundation | Core build concepts |
| Build Management | Configuration and automation |
| Build Operations | Environments and optimization |
| Governance | Validation and security |

# Build Model

FamilyOS build management follows:

1. Define build requirements
2. Configure build environment
3. Execute build process
4. Validate generated artifacts
5. Publish reliable outputs

---

# Build Integration

The Build Framework integrates with:

| Framework | Purpose |
|---|---|
| Engineering Framework | Development standards |
| Testing Framework | Validation confidence |
| Quality Framework | Quality assurance |
| Release Framework | Delivery process |
| Security Framework | Build protection |

---

# Naming Convention

Build documents SHALL follow:


BLD-XXXX-Document-Name.md


Identifiers SHALL remain unique and SHALL NOT be reused.
